name: Banh day
summary: Bánh dầy is the third cake on the national Sa Pa list, with bánh ngô and bánh đao. The page does not describe the rice or a filling.
origin: The national Sa Pa food paragraph.
howToEat: In Sa Pa, it is one of three local cakes with bánh ngô and bánh đao.
At Hang Kia in Mai Châu, bánh dày is served among the Hmong-village dishes.
where: Sa Pa, among the town's local cakes.
